node_1.description: This is Maeve Millay's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00am, have breakfast and walk to Hobbs Cafe by 8:00am, work at Hobbs Cafe from 8:00am to 4:00pm, walk in Johnson Park from 4:00pm to 6:00pm, have dinner at the dorm at 8:00pm, spend time in her room from 9:00pm to 11:00pm, go to bed at 11:00pm.
